events.title: Day 3 sailing around the world without stopping
events.summary: A short published on 6 October titled as day 3 of the nonstop circumnavigation. No transcript is stored. The map uses the tracker report nearest the publication time, which may not be the moment he filmed.

events.title: LIVE - Sailing Alone Around The World Without Stopping
events.summary: His YouTube broadcast from the first days at sea. Playback time and the GPS tracker are separate feeds and are not synchronized here. A later replay would need a reviewed recording and time anchors.

events.title: Day 2 sailing around the world without stopping.
events.summary: A short published on 5 October titled as day 2. The pin is aligned to publication time, not a verified filming clock.

events.title: doing something everyone’s done to something less then 200 people in human existence have ever done.
events.summary: A short posted on 4 October. The public title is the text we have; there is no transcript, so nothing here is treated as a report of conditions, sleep, or a repair.

events.title: October 2, 2026
events.summary: A short published the morning of the departure, a couple of hours after the announced 07:00 send-off. Placed on the tracker report nearest that publication time.

events.title: 1 Day Until I Set Sail Around The World Without Stopping
events.summary: A 29-minute video published the day before leaving. He describes the planned solo nonstop circumnavigation from Port Townsend aboard Phoenix do Mar. The boat’s tracker was still at the marina.

events.title: 1 day until I sail around the world without stopping. Thank you @PurinaFriskies for everything.
events.summary: A countdown short the day before departure. The title thanks Purina Friskies. The boat was still alongside in Port Townsend.

events.title: Regardless of what happens, I have already won. Because I have found the courage to try.
events.summary: A short published on 21 September, while the boat was still in Port Townsend. The title is the public text; it is not read here as a report of conditions at sea.

events.title: 13 days until I sail around the world without stopping. Shout out @ring for supporting the trip! #ad
events.summary: A countdown short. The title is marked as an advertisement and shouts out Ring. Included as a published post, not as a condition or equipment report.

events.title: Am I Ready To Sail Nonstop Around The World?
events.summary: Published 10 September. He describes it as part of a five-day sea trial in the Pacific to test a new sail inventory. The video does not name the calendar days, so the highlight is the offshore track from 2–8 September, which is the matching movement on the public tracker. That association is approximate.

events.title: 25 days until I attempt to sail around the world without stopping.
events.summary: A countdown short published while the September sea trial was underway. Publication time is not the same thing as a filmed position, so the pin is only the nearest tracker report.

events.title: 26 days until I sail around the world without stopping.
events.summary: A countdown short published during the September offshore trip. Aligned to the nearest tracker report around publication.

events.title: 38 days until I sail around the world without stopping
events.summary: A countdown video in late August. He restates the plan to leave Port Townsend in October aboard Phoenix do Mar. Placed only if the tracker has a nearby report.

events.title: Thanks Ben! @liferaftprofessionals
events.summary: A short thanking a life-raft supplier during final preparation. It is not a report that the raft was used.

events.title: First Sail Alone Since Sailing To Hawai'i
events.summary: He frames this as the first sail alone since the Hawaiʻi passage, on the Pacific Seacraft 40 he was preparing for the circumnavigation. The pin follows the public tracker around the publication time.

events.title: 64 Days Until I Sail Nonstop Around The World
events.summary: A July countdown video. Included so the early Port Townsend preparation has a source on the map when the tracker has a report that day.

events.title: Phoenix Do Mar Is Born
events.summary: The renaming video for the Pacific Seacraft 40. The public tracker has no reliable position that week, so this card has no pin.

events.title: My Rudder FAILED in the Pacific… So I Tore it Apart
events.summary: Published during the refit. He describes a rudder failure from the earlier Pacific passage and a later teardown. The clock time and position of the failure are not established here, so this is filed as a report with unknown occurrence time — not a pin on the October voyage, and not a continuous equipment score.

events.title: Installing a Watermaker So I Don’t Die of Thirst Mid-Ocean
events.summary: A refit video about installing a watermaker. The title is blunt; it is preparation footage, not a report that he ran out of water. No tracker position is available for this week.

events.title: Route Planning My Solo Nonstop Circumnavigation
events.summary: A route-planning video published in February 2026. No position is attached: the public tracker does not have a trustworthy fix that day.

events.title: Sailing My New Boat to Port Townsend
events.summary: He published this about bringing the new boat to Port Townsend. The public SY_Phoenix track does not cover that delivery, so the card stays unpinned rather than guessing a route.

events.title: Leaves Point Hudson
events.summary: The Port Townsend Sailing Association announced a flotilla send-off for 07:00 on Friday, 2 October 2026, from Point Hudson. Peninsula Daily News reported Phoenix do Mar leaving the marina that morning. The pin is the marina, not a tracker coordinate.

storylines.title: Leaving Port Townsend
storylines.summary: The send-off and the first posts after Phoenix do Mar left Point Hudson on 2 October 2026.

storylines.title: September sea trial
storylines.summary: An offshore stretch in early September that matches his description of a five-day sail trial. The dates are inferred from the tracker, not named in the video.

storylines.title: Countdown
storylines.summary: Public countdown posts from the Port Townsend preparation. Several are ashore. Sponsored titles are labeled from the post itself.

storylines.title: Refit notes
storylines.summary: Preparation videos from before the tracker is trustworthy again. Most have no position.

storylines.title: Rudder, reported later
storylines.summary: A failure he has described from the earlier passage, published as a teardown during the refit. Occurrence time and place are unresolved.

broadcasts.title: LIVE - Sailing Alone Around The World Without Stopping
broadcasts.note: Start and end come from YouTube's broadcast metadata when the seed was built. They are not a reviewed map of playback time to UTC, and they do not describe Twitch.

broadcasts.note: He links this channel. Live status is only asserted when a Twitch app token is configured.
